mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_payment (payment_no, order_no, amount, channel, status, idempotency_key, callback_time, create_time) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{orderNo}, #{amount}, #{channel}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_no, order_no, amount, channel, status, idempotency_key, callback_time, create_time FROM pet_payment WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY (status = 'SUCCESS') DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, payment_no, order_no, amount, channel, status, idempotency_key, callback_time, create_time FROM pet_payment WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} UNION ALL SELECT p.id,p.payment_no,p.order_no,p.amount,p.channel,p.status,p.idempotency_key,p.callback_time,p.create_time FROM pet_payment_request r JOIN pet_payment p ON p.id=r.payment_id WHERE r.idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
